events.name: P1A_PUBLICATION
events.requirement: Publish the complete executable protocol and all component digests without candidate identities, statements, rankings, or outcomes.

events.name: P1T_PUBLICATION_AND_RECEIPT
events.requirement: Publish a one-artifact attestation of P1A and prove that the public remote contains P1T.

events.name: U1_CAPTURE
events.requirement: Only after the public P1T receipt, execute the single frozen baseline capture of upstream main and bind its commit and trees.

events.name: SCHEDULED_ACCUMULATION_CHECKPOINTS
events.requirement: At 00:17 UTC daily, a schedule-triggered GitHub Actions run captures canonical upstream main and emits identity-only receipts, hashes, aggregate stratum counts, and a quota certificate. Manual dispatches and reruns are not checkpoints. If the oldest unpublished tick is detected at or after its 06:00 UTC deadline, publish only a bounded INVALID_CHRONOLOGY_CAPTURE terminal bundle; catch-up and later target capture are forbidden.

events.name: FIRST_PASS_OR_FIXED_HORIZON
events.requirement: The first scheduled checkpoint whose aggregate counts meet every quota becomes U2. If none passes, the fixed last checkpoint terminates for quota deficit or chronology failure.

events.name: U2_CAPTURE_AND_HISTORY_REPLAY
events.requirement: Bind U2, prove U1 ancestry and that no prior valid checkpoint passed, and deterministically compute first introductions in U1..U2.

events.name: PRE_SELECTION_SOURCE_CUTOFF
events.requirement: Acquire and classify every frozen semantic source from P1 through cutoff; semantic or unknown contact excludes the whole cluster.

events.name: QUOTA_GATE
events.requirement: Recompute the future cohort and exact 3/3/2/2/2 counts before entropy.

events.name: ENTROPY_AND_SELECTION_IF_GATE_PASSES
events.requirement: Freeze the eligible pool publicly, then use the inherited future drand selector; otherwise terminate without entropy.

fixed_horizon.selection_basis: Chosen in the pre-P1 scaffold as an approximately one-year hard no-quota deadline.

checkpoint_schedule.publication_genesis: A sole-parent child of exact P1T adding only u1/chronology-receipt.json
checkpoint_schedule.checkpoint_commit_shape: Each checkpoint is one sole-parent add-only commit adding exactly the three frozen artifacts under its tick path
checkpoint_schedule.previous_receipt_authority: Derived from the exact public Git ref ancestry, including introducing commit, path, and blob digest; caller-selected predecessor bytes are not authoritative
checkpoint_schedule.public_ref_rewrite_policy: Every accepted chain is anchored at P1T and every publication uses a normal atomic fast-forward push from the verified tip
checkpoint_schedule.expired_tick_policy: The first expired unpublished tick terminates as INVALID_CHRONOLOGY_CAPTURE; it is never reconstructed and the workflow never advances to a later tick
